app.description: Guitarmateur Practice: a free pentatonic and blues trainer. Pick a scale and a box, add the chords of your song, and get licks that land on the chord tones.
app.playAlongNote: Play along here in the browser, or put on your own backing track and solo over it.
app.subtitle: Pick a scale, add the chords of your song, and get a short lick for each chord that lands on a chord tone.

practice.empty: Add chords in step 2 to get licks.
practice.intro: Each lick ends on a chord tone, the target note: one of its own chord, or of the next chord when “Lead into the next chord” is on. Landing there is what makes a solo sound like it follows the chords.
practice.takeaway: Aim for the target note on each chord change; the notes before it are the way there.
practice.tryIt: Play along at a slow tempo with the target note on root. When that feels easy, switch it to 3rd and hear how the licks change.
progression.advancedToggleAria: Show or hide the chord picker
progression.barsToggle: {chord}, {bars}: click to switch between 1 and 2 bars
progression.empty: No chords yet. Click a suggestion above to start.
progression.intro: Add the chords of your backing track, in order. Each chord gets its own lick, so the note you aim for changes when the chord does.
progression.takeaway: The same chords, in the same order and for the same number of bars, as the backing track you play over.
progression.tryIt: Not sure of the chords? Start from the suggestions: they are the chords of this key. Click ×1 on a chord to give it 2 bars.
scalebox.intro: Pick the key of your backing track and a box to play in. Every lick below stays inside the box, so your hand learns one place on the neck at a time.
scalebox.takeaway: One key, one box: know where the root sits before anything else.
scalebox.tryIt: Play the box up and down. Then play only its roots, from the lowest to the highest.
